answer: Each agent identity is sealed to a TPM chip at registration, then must sign an unbroken hourly heartbeat for 30 days before transacting. A newcomer who cannot wait posts a 5,000-POA bond co-signed by an established sponsor staking the same sum. If either side farms duplicates, both bonds are slashed and the seat burned. Forging 200 identities costs 2,000,000 POA and 200 real chips. A juniper windbreak on a basalt wall holds because every tree is separately rooted; copy the leaves and the gale still finds the gap. Sybils get no haven, only a bill.
